info.name: HustleHub+ API - Final
info.description: Full API + security suite: auth, lockout, token revocation, gigs, ownership, bookings, ledger-sealed transactions, tax/income dashboard data, RBAC, admin ledger verification, headers, injection and token-tampering checks. Run in order. Prerequisites: server running over HTTPS and `npm run seed:admin` executed (the Docker stack seeds the admin itself). Self-signed certificate: use Newman --insecure or disable SSL verification in Postman.

exec: pm.test('Password / hash never returned', () => { const u = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property('password'); });
pm.test('Explains the password is too common', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().errors)).to.include('too common'));

item.name: Register - malformed JSON (400, no parser details leaked)

exec: pm.test('Generic message only', () => { const m = pm.response.json().message; pm.expect(m).to.eql('Malformed JSON in request body'); });

item.name: Login admin - success (requires npm run seed:admin)

exec: pm.test('Same generic message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));

item.name: Lockout - correct password is now refused (429 + Retry-After)

exec: pm.test('Generic message, no account details', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Too many failed login attempts. Please try again later.'));

item.name: Lockout - unknown e-mail gets the same 401 as a wrong password
Revocation - same token is rejected after logout (401)
Revocation - logging in again gives a working token (200)

exec: pm.test('Owned by the authenticated freelancer', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.gig.freelancerName).to.eql('Frankie Freelancer'));

item.name: Create gig - HTML stripped from input (201)

exec: pm.test('No HTML stored', () => { const g = pm.response.json().data.gig; pm.expect(g.title).to.not.include('<'); pm.expect(g.description).to.not.include('<'); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Mass assignment test",
  "description": "Trying to set someone else as owner.",
  "category": "Other",
  "price": 10,
  "freelancerId": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",
  "active": false
}

exec: pm.test('Owner is still the caller and gig is active', () => { const g = pm.response.json().data.gig; pm.expect(g.freelancerName).to.eql('Frankie Freelancer'); pm.expect(g.active).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Update gig owned by another freelancer (403)
Delete gig owned by another freelancer (403)
Book gig - client (201) creates booking + transaction

exec: pm.test('Booking and transaction created', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.booking.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.transaction.bookingId).to.eql(d.booking.id); });

pm.test('Transaction links both users and uses server-side price', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.transaction.clientId).to.eql(d.booking.clientId); pm.expect(d.transaction.freelancerId).to.eql(d.booking.freelancerId); pm.expect(d.transaction.amount).to.eql(550); });

item.name: My bookings - freelancer sees bookings on own gigs (200)
My bookings - other freelancer sees none (200)

exec: pm.test('Income tracked for the correct freelancer', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.totalEarned).to.eql(550); pm.expect(d.bookingCount).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('Tax estimate: below threshold so no tax, rebate and brackets shown', () => { const t = pm.response.json().data.tax; pm.expect(t.estimatedTax).to.eql(0); pm.expect(t.rebate).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(t.brackets).to.have.lengthOf(7); pm.expect(t.taxThreshold).to.be.above(90000); });

pm.test('Dashboard data: 12 months, per-gig earnings, tax year, method', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.monthly).to.have.lengthOf(12); pm.expect(d.byGig[0].income).to.eql(550); pm.expect(d.taxYear.label).to.match(/^\d{4}\/\d{2}$/); pm.expect(d.method.steps).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

item.name: Income - explicit earlier tax year has no income (200)

exec: pm.test('2025/26 table used, nothing earned', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.taxYear.label).to.eql('2025/26'); pm.expect(d.totalEarned).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Hash chain is valid and covers the new transaction', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.valid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.verified).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Security headers present, no server fingerprint

exec: pm.test('Request id returned for log correlation', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/));

item.name: Oversized request body rejected (413, generic message)

exec: pm.test('No internals leaked', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Request body is too large'));
